records.text: Long Beach Airport is a 10-to-15-minute drive from Joint Forces Training Base Los Alamitos, and U.S. government officials commonly use that base when traveling to Southern California.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep UYkXV9mYbT4)

appearances.snippet: She wrote, FYI, the Long Beach Airport is a quick 10 to 15 minute drive to a small military base in Los Alamitos. ... It is the Joint Forces Air Base. ... Um, she continued, it is common for U.S. government officials to fly in and out of that base when coming to Southern California and then driving to fundraising events, etc.

verification.notes: The proximity is broadly supported: current route information places Long Beach Airport about five miles and roughly eight minutes from Los Alamitos, while official California National Guard sources locate the Joint Forces Training Base in Los Alamitos and confirm that it supports state and federal agencies and has distinguished-visitor facilities. Government records also document presidential use of its airfield for Orange County visits. No reliable source found supports the broader claim that U.S. officials commonly use this base whenever traveling to Southern California, so that portion remains unestablished.
